newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin has early signs of pneumonia - Russian TV.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin has early signs of pneumonia - Russian TV.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has early signs of pneumonia and doctors have ordered him to go to hospital, Russian television quoted a Kremlin satement as saying on Wednesday.
Yeltsin, 65, who had a heart bypass operation on November 5, had already cancelled his appointments since Monday because of what the Kremlin said was a heavy cold.
"Doctors have stated that the first signs of pneumonia developing have appeared," said the statement.

"In connection with this, in order to make a better diagnosis and to conduct appropriate treatment, a decision has been taken to take him to the Central Clinical Hospital (in Moscow) for several days," the television said.
